text:
Nico (CS): quick roundup from this week's onboarding / procurement calls. recurring asks across pilots - putting them here so product can triage.
Nico (CS): three themes: 1) per-route cost controls (toggle or quota), 2) detect & surface stale embeddings, 3) one-click CSV export of customer asks with severity + renewal flag.
Nico (CS): verbatims:
- "We need to stop embeddings on a specific marketing route during off-hours, it's eating credits." — BlueHarbor
- "We re-upload weekly and end up with duplicates; can you tell us when vectors are stale?" — MeadowClinic
- "If CS can export prioritized asks with a renewal-impact flag, PMs can act faster." — RetailSphere
Aria (Product): thanks. can you attach numbers: cost deltas, whether renewal is at-risk?
Nico (CS): BlueHarbor: ~$650/mo extra on pilot, they say renewal conversation is conditional. MeadowClinic: mainly annoyance, not blocking renewal. RetailSphere: export would speed internal triage, not blocking.
Sam (Solutions): quick workaround: add a route attribute "cost_sensitive" in support DB and expose a filtered export. minimal change.
Diego (Eng-ML): per-route hard-toggle is tricky for batching and cache. alternatives: sampling/quota or soft-disable that keeps cached vectors but excludes from heavy batch windows.
Diego (Eng-ML): staleness signal idea: last_indexed_ts vs last_query_ts + sample drift check (cosine threshold). prototype in indexer in 1 sprint.
Aria (Product): proposed triage list: A) CSV export (columns: account, route, ask, severity, renewal_risk, quote, est_cost_usd, date); B) support export filter + route tag UX; C) staleness detector + alerts; D) investigate per-route quota/hard-toggle.
Nico (CS): CSV export is high-priority for procurement docs. can Exporter Bot run a quick dump?
Exporter Bot: created export job id=exp_1751230000_v1 -> s3://cs-exports/1751230000_customer_asks.csv
Sam (Solutions): i'll add the route tag filter to support export endpoint. ETA Tue EOD.
Aria (Product): Diego, can you give rough eng estimate for staleness prototype?
Diego (Eng-ML): prototype: 1 sprint; robust pipeline + UI: 3 sprints.
Aria (Product): Nico, please DM the BlueHarbor billing extract and I'll add numbers to the RICE card. scheduling 30m triage Fri 11am PT.
Nico (CS): will DM now. adding verbatims to the RICE card.
Exporter Bot: export completed: s3://cs-exports/1751230000_customer_asks.csv (7 rows) :white_check_mark:
Nico (CS): thanks all — will follow up after the triage. :thumbsup:
